camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi RefundInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ImmediatelyRelease 1 --ProductCode ecs --InstanceId 'i-bp1etb69sqxgl40000000' --ProductType '空字符串' --ClientToken '793F021C-B589-1225-82A9-99232AEBE494'
description_en: Cancels subscriptions for instances that you no longer need
description_zh: 调用本接口退订不再需要的实例
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi refund-instance --client-token 793F021C-B589-1225-82A9-99232AEBE494 --immediately-release 1 --product-code ecs --instance-id i-bp1etb69sqxgl40000000 --product-type '空字符串' --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RefundInstance

parameters.help_en: A client-generated universally unique identifier (UUID) that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. If you make multiple calls with the same ClientToken, the system returns the result of the first call. A successful call returns a refund order ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要幂等场景必填。UUID生成的字符串。此字段用于幂等，多次调用传入同样的值，会返回第一次的结果。调用后如果返回了结果，可以解析到退款订单编号，代表调用成功
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required for unsubscription. Valid values: 1: The instance is released immediately. 0: The instance is first stopped according to its stop policy. This feature is supported only for some products. By default, instances are released immediately
parameters.help_zh: 退订场景必填。1：标识立即释放。0：标识先停机，根据停机策略停机。仅部分商品支持。默认都是立即释放
parameters.name: immediately_release

parameters.help_en: The product code. This parameter is required for unsubscription. If an error code indicates that the product is not supported, submit a ticket to request that this feature be enabled
parameters.help_zh: 退订场景必填，产品code。如果调用后错误码提示产品不支持，可提交工单申请云产品允许开通此功能
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. This is not a custom name. This parameter is required for unsubscription
parameters.help_zh: 退订场景必填，实例id，非自定义名称
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The product type. This parameter is required for unsubscription. Unless otherwise specified, pass an empty string. In API Explorer, you can automatically enter an empty string by moving your mouse pointer over the input box and clicking the button that appears. When you call this operation from your code, pass an empty string ""
parameters.help_zh: 退订场景必填，产品类型，无特殊说明传入空字符串。在调试工具上，无需手动输入，鼠标放到输入框上，会弹出"输入空字符串"的按钮，点击此按钮即可。通过代码发起退订时，传入英文字符下的空字符串 ""
parameters.name: product_type
